author: mark
text:
Phase 6: schema regen + final string sweep [bl-d135]

Schema rename to match the v0.3 two-file split (ARCH §4.1):
schemas/providers.json is the per-repo shape (roles only),
schemas/global-providers.json is the harness-root shape (endpoints,
auth, models). The old schemas/per_repo_providers.json file is
retired; gen-schemas emits the new pair.

README gains an explicit "Layout: harness root and conversation
repos" section so the two-tier structure is the first thing a reader
encounters, plus a table mapping each schemas/*.json to the Rust
type and on-disk file it covers. One stale (v0.2) cross-reference
in the providers section fixed. The Providers Rust struct's docstring
now identifies it as the harness-root file so the generated schema
description is self-explanatory.

String sweep (.agent/, exchanges/, invocations/, ex/<, inv/<,
agents.yaml across src/ crates/ template/ tests/ README.md
AGENTS.md): only remaining hits are explicit v0.1/v0.2 historical
references in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §12 milestones, the v0.5 UI
skeleton's v0.1/v0.2-shape git_tree renderer, and one pure-tense
"v0.2 split" comment in workflow_check.rs -- all kept per the
"historical references stay" rule.

The fs_watcher's WATCHED_PREFIXES constant and the git_tree renderer
still target v0.1/v0.2 paths -- filed as bl-3465 under the v0.5 UI
epic rather than expanding this cleanup ball.

All gates pass: cargo fmt --check clean, cargo clippy -D warnings
clean, cargo test --workspace 100% pass, tarpaulin 100% line
coverage. Alignment checked against ARCH §2.2/§4.1, PRINCIPLES
single-source-of-truth, and TAXONOMY.
